verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS research product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a vendor-hosted service: the MCP endpoint is at mcp.undermind.ai and enterprise features are API, MCP and data removal. Nothing documents a self-hosted, on-prem or downloadable deployment of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
